title: Rune
content:
{{article game navigation}} : ''{{Hatnote|You may also be looking for [[Rune (Historical)]], a retired feature of the game.}}'' [[File:Runes 2018.jpg|thumb|360px]]'''Runes''' are enhancements that add new abilities or buffs to the champion. The player can choose their loadout of runes before the match begins, during champion select, or their Collection tab. Runes Reforged (the current system of runes) was introduced in Pre-[[Season 2018]], supplanting the previous system of [[Runes (Historical)|Runes]] and [[Summoner Mastery|Masteries]], hence the name '''Reforged'''.[https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://na.leagueoflegends.com/en/featured/preseason-update Preseason Update][https://web.archive.org/web/0/https://na.leagueoflegends.com/en/news/game-updates/patch/patch-722-notes#patch-experience Patch 7.22 notes][https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://na.leagueoflegends.com/en/featured/preseason-update/8200-8230 Check out my build] == Rune Pages == [[File:Rune_pages_inventory.jpg|thumb|right|400px|Rune page inventory]] A player can have a maximum of 25 custom [[Rune Book|rune pages]], which are separate from the recommended rune page which cannot be edited and only exists per-game. Players in [[Experience (summoner)| levels 1 to 9]] cannot create nor edit rune pages. New accounts have two empty rune pages available; additional pages are purchased in the store for {{RP|590}} or {{BE|6300}} each. It is not possible to enter a match without an active, valid rune page. In such a case, the game will automatically assign the player with the recommended rune page for their champion and role, upon game start. {{clr}} === Rune Recommender === [[File:Rune recommender.png|thumb|right|350px|Rune recommender]] Hovering or locking in a champion in the Champion Selection screen allows you to access the Rune Recommender button on the left side of the loadout. The Rune Recommender automatically determines and recommends the best rune sets for your chosen champion and role, and presents up to three different sets. You can select a set in order to apply it to your loadout. * These recommended rune sets are updated per-patch based on current data and the best runes available for each champion in each role. * Optionally, the Rune Recommender can also recommend [[Summoner spell|summoner spell]] loadouts. The option can be enabled or disabled at will by clicking on the slider at the bottom of the Rune Recommender (this option persists through Champion Selection lobbies). {{clr}} == Rune paths == Runes are divided into five ''paths'': [[File:Rune icon.png|right|100px]] * [[File:Precision icon.png|20px|link=]] '''Precision''' - Improved attacks and sustained damage * [[File:Domination icon.png|20px|link=]] '''Domination''' - Burst damage and target access * [[File:Sorcery icon.png|20px|link=]] '''Sorcery''' - Empowered abilities and resource manipulation * [[File:Resolve icon.png|20px|link=]] '''Resolve''' - Durability and crowd control * [[File:Inspiration icon.png|20px|link=]] '''Inspiration''' - Creative tools and rule bending [[File:In-Game Runes.png|thumb|right|250px]] Each rune page contains runes from two paths: one primary and one secondary. The primary path has one keystone and three lesser runes. The secondary path has two lesser runes. There are also three ''Shard'' slots alongside the Primary and Secondary paths that follow a path separate from the five. Each individual slot can be filled with one selection. {{clr}} === Trees === {| border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" class="article-table rune-table" width="100%" style="font-size:14px; text-align:center; background:transparent;" ! width="100px" style="text-align:center;" | Paths ! width="20%" style="text-align:center;" | Keystone ! width="20%" style="text-align:center;" | Slot 1 ! width="20%" style="text-align:center;" | Slot 2 ! width="20%" style="text-align:center;" | Slot 3 {{Rune table row|Precision}} {{Rune table row|Domination}} {{Rune table row|Sorcery}} {{Rune table row|Resolve}} {{Rune table row|Inspiration}} |} === Shards === {|class="article-table" width="100%" style="text-align:center;" ! !

The game will substitute unusable runes automatically upon the game start and print a chat message to the player with the change. :''Last updated: [[V26.06]]'' * In modes without the river, {{ri|Waterwalking}} is exchanged with {{ri|Scorch}}. * In modes without [[structures]] or where structures are impervious, {{ri|Demolish}} is exchanged with {{ri|Font of Life}}. * In modes without [[ward]]s, {{ri|Deep Ward}} and {{ri|Sixth Sense}} are exchanged with {{ri|Grisly Mementos}}. * For champions without {{tip|mana}}, {{ri|Manaflow Band}} is exchanged with {{ri|Axiom Arcanist}}. * For champions without {{tip|mana}} nor {{tip|energy}}, {{ri|Presence of Mind}} is exchanged with {{ri|Triumph}}. * For champions without immobilizing effects, {{ri|Aftershock}} is exchanged with {{ri|Grasp of the Undying}} and {{ri|Glacial Augment}} is exchanged with {{ri|First Strike}}. ** {{ci|Yorick}} is an exception to this rule and considered to not have an immobilizing effect despite having an immobilize on his {{ai|W|Yorick}}. * For champions that do not equip {{si|Flash}}, {{ri|Hextech Flashtraption}} is exchanged with {{ri|Cash Back}}. * For {{ci|Bel'Veth}}, {{ri|Ultimate Hunter}} is exchanged with {{ri|Relentless Hunter}}. * For {{ci|Samira}}, {{ri|Ultimate Hunter}} is exchanged with {{ri|Treasure Hunter}}. * For {{ci|Elise}}, {{ci|Jayce}}, {{ci|Nidalee}} and {{ci|Zoe}}, {{ri|Axiom Arcanist}} is exchanged with {{ri|Nimbus Cloak}}. * In [[Ultra Rapid Fire|URF]]: ** {{ri|Unsealed Spellbook}} is exchanged with {{ri|First Strike}}. ** {{ri|Manaflow Band}} is exchanged with {{ri|Axiom Arcanist}}. ** {{ri|Presence of Mind}} is exchanged with {{ri|Triumph}}. * In [[Ultimate Spellbook]]: ** {{ri|Unsealed Spellbook}} is exchanged with {{ri|First Strike}}. == Trivia == [[File:Sorcery Path Animation.gif|center]] * During development, Precision and Sorcery were originally going to be Primary path only.[https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://na.leagueoflegends.com/en/news/game-updates/features/coming-preseason-runes-reforged Announcement] * Runes are referred to internally as "perks".[https://raw.communitydragon.org/latest/plugins/rcp-be-lol-game-data/global/default/v1/perk-images/styles/ CommunityDragon] * Runes and their surrounding areas have distinct visual appearances which bear similarities to certain Runeterran factions. client offered five ''preset'' rune pages that could not be edited, but were viewable in the player's Collection tab. Also, if an invalid rune page was selected, it was substituted for one of the preset rune pages upon game start. The preset selection depended on your champion's traits. The Timeless (Preset).png|{{sbc|Inspiration: The Timeless}} (Inspiration + Resolve) The Prefect (Preset).png|{{sbc|Precision: The Perfect}} (Precision + Sorcery) The Executioner (Preset).png|{{sbc|Domination: The Executioner}} (Domination + Precision) The Colossus (Preset).png|{{sbc|Resolve: The Colossus}} (Resolve + Sorcery) The Calamity (Preset).png|{{sbc|Sorcery: The Calamity}} (Sorcery + Domination) Example_Rune_Page.png|Personalized Rune Page * 'The Perfect' preset was originally called 'The Prefect,' as with the Set Title. It is unknown why this was changed. === Rune traits === Prior to the introduction of Shards in [[V8.23]], players received a bonus based on the combination of their sets (e.g. Sorcery + Precision). style="text-align:center; background: #050c13;" | — |} === Champion stat adjustments === After the launch of Runes Reforged, the balance of champion stats was heavily impacted due to their dependence on the old Rune system's direct stat buffs. * The following generalize the changes made to compensate for the loss of attack damage from ''marks'' and health or armor from ''seals'', which were almost unanimously used due to the lack of options (and thus the game has been balanced, for example, around most champions having 9 bonus armor from ''seals''). The exact values may vary for specific cases, as Riot also took this opportunity to better distinguish classes (e.g., tanks from non-tanks; ranged from melee), as well as buff or nerf specific champions. ** AD champions had the base damage on their abilities increased by 5. *** Ranged AD champions also had their '''base''' attack damage increased by 8. ** Most champions had their '''base''' armor increased by 9. *** Most mages had their '''base''' health increased by 12, instead. ''Primarily excluding junglers.'' *** Melee supports had their '''base''' armor increased by 20, instead. {{Clr}} == Patch History == {{scroll box|content= ;[[V25.22]] * Stat Shards ** Bonus movement
